name: cv-baseline-v3
hypothesis: THE ANCHOR for the cv-medium-v3 era: the simplest thing that could work, so every later result is an addition justified against it. Bare linear probe on frozen YAMNet — Dense(15) straight off the 1024-d embedding, NO dropout, no hidden layer — label_smoothing 0.2, Adam 0.002, --fixed-epochs 400 (no early stopping, no epoch selection), medium at 8 rotating folds, translation general.
conclusion:
0.330 headline (excl. quiet+faint), 0.269 inclusive, 8/8 folds scored. NOT comparable to the archived era: different annotations, 8 rotating folds instead of 5, no dropout, and a fixed budget instead of val_loss early stopping. The archived cv-baseline 0.218 is not its predecessor in any readable sense.

THE TIER BREAKDOWN IS THE RESULT WORTH KEEPING, and it is monotonic in audibility at one shared threshold: loud 0.778 (122 frames, 5/8 folds) > untagged 0.350 > background 0.322 > quiet 0.070 > faint 0.000. That is strong independent support for the scoring split — quiet buzz is caught 7% of the time and faint never, so counting them as misses was measuring a target the tool was never promised to hit. It also says the model is not broadly weak: on buzz an operator would call audible it is at 0.78.

CAVEAT ON 1_29 AND 53, the two richest folds. _background annotations are 1874 of their buzz frames (254s median duration vs ~1s for every other tier, 51% of all scored buzz seconds) and appear in no other fold. Their 0.441 and 0.429 are therefore substantially a measure of continuous background buzz, not of discrete events. Scored as buzz per Luke 2026-09-11; TIERS_EXCLUDED_FROM_HEADLINE plus resummarize.py flips it with no retraining.

1_95 remains the known failure at 0.052, with threshold -0.137 against -1.4 to -1.9 everywhere else — the jet-flyover pathology from the archived era, unchanged by any of this.

BUDGET: fold peaks scatter 116-398 and mean(last 21 epochs) - mean(e300-320) is -0.003 to +0.013, so 400 is not obviously short. This is NOT last era, where every fixed-budget run was still climbing at its cap. The ladder is still worth one run to set the era budget, but it is no longer urgent.
